trickyParts: The WARN is written by store.Registry.Get through the registry's JSON logger, since sessionsHandler(registry, sessions) keeps its signature (the red test calls it); it fires once per read of the record on any path.

Sweep: no other path sends a store or session-store decode error to writeBusUnavailable, refuseBusUnavailable or outcomeBusUnavailable. An undecodable session record is evicted by SessionRegistry.applyWatched and reads as absent (404 on a send); senderStamp and agent delivery drop the interest error and carry on.

A subscribe over an unreadable record replaces it: role claims are kept (they live in envoy_roles, which Upsert never touches); the old topics, MachineID, Dir and UpdatedAt are replaced, none of which this build could read or route. [INFERENCE] residual: during a rolling deploy another build that can decode the record would see it overwritten; that needs a field whose type changed, or corrupt bytes.
deviations: Unsubscribe with a topic list over an unreadable record answers 200, releases the role claims those topics name and leaves the record unchanged with a WARN; /v1/roles/set no longer answers 500 after a claim landed over an old holder's unreadable record (both approved by the architect, 09:21Z).
